news.title: MixForge has a Home
news.body: MixForge now opens on a Home screen: your projects as files you can rename, duplicate and delete, a curated feed of sets and techniques that reorders itself around the artists and genres you follow, and a place for news like this. The feed lives in a public repo and refreshes while you work.

releases.title: Home and projects
notes: A Home screen with your projects, the feed and news.
Projects are now files: create, rename, duplicate and delete them.
A curated feed of sets, mashups and techniques, refreshed every few hours.
A welcome page and profile so Home can favour your artists and genres.
A Settings page for launch behaviour, export folder and transition defaults.
